name: Chattanooga
tagline: Gig City with the Fastest Internet, No State Income Tax, and Outdoor Paradise
description: Chattanooga is a FIRE dream: no state income tax, the fastest municipal internet in the United States courtesy of EPB Fiber Optics, and a cost of living well below the national average. Nestled along the Tennessee River at the base of Lookout Mountain, the city has transformed from an industrial center into an outdoor recreation capital with world-class rock climbing, mountain biking, and paddling. The revitalized downtown features excellent restaurants, a thriving arts scene, and the stunning Tennessee Aquarium.

quickFacts.visa: No visa required for US citizens
quickFacts.internetSpeed: 300+ Mbps average (EPB Fiber offers up to 25 Gbps)
quickFacts.safetyRating: Moderate – safe neighborhoods; improving downtown area
quickFacts.climate: Humid subtropical with mild winters, warm summers, and long pleasant spring and fall seasons

housing.description: Cheapest-acceptable studio or older 1BR in Highland Park, Brainerd, or a Riverview/Southside fringe

dining.description: Casual local spots like Champy's a few times a week; mostly home cooking

healthcare.description: A subsidized Silver plan on Tennessee's ACA exchange, assuming annual income stays under the 2026 subsidy cutoff of about $62,600 for a single person. Priced for an early retiree aged 45-55; older retirees should budget more.

transportation.description: A paid-off used car with insurance (cheap ~$134/mo local rates); the free CARTA electric shuttle covers downtown only

entertainment.description: Hiking Lookout Mountain, climbing at Sunset Rock, Riverwalk strolls, free gallery nights

1M.lifestyle: A cheapest-acceptable studio or older one-bedroom in Highland Park or on the Southside, with home cooking the norm and casual meals at spots like Champy's a few times a week. Tennessee levies no state income tax, so more of each withdrawal stays in pocket, and EPB's gigabit fiber keeps connectivity cheap. Free time goes to hiking Lookout Mountain, climbing at Sunset Rock, and walking the Riverwalk. The ACA Silver premium stays low if MAGI is managed under the 2026 ~$62,600 cliff. A frugal but genuinely outdoorsy base.

2M.lifestyle: A decent one-bedroom on the Northshore or a cottage in St. Elmo at the base of Lookout Mountain, dining out several times a week across the growing Southside scene. A climbing-gym or aquarium membership, live music, and events like Riverbend fill the weeks, with biking and paddling the Tennessee River on weekends. No state income tax and affordable costs leave a healthy monthly margin.

10M.lifestyle: A trophy estate on Lookout Mountain or a Signal Mountain compound with acreage, housekeeping several days a week, regular private-chef evenings, and a second home in the Smokies within reach. First-class travel, concierge healthcare with specialist access in Nashville or Atlanta, and generous community involvement are all well covered. With Chattanooga's low cost base and no state income tax, roughly $184k a year funds a very comfortable, well-supported life with large monthly margins.
